intent_signals: Management company lists residential communities on their website with average home values $500K+
Regional Director or VP Operations title visible on LinkedIn at a national/regional property management company
Company portfolio page shows 5+ HOA communities in a BN Tier-1 or Tier-2 territory
CAI (Community Associations Institute) chapter membership or event sponsorship listed on company site
Job postings for Community Manager or CAM roles in target territories (signals active portfolio growth)
Company website mentions gated, resort-style, or master-planned community management as a specialty
Preferred vendor list or vendor onboarding portal visible on company site
exclusions: Commercial property management companies (office, retail, industrial portfolios only)
Management companies with fewer than 5 communities in BN territories
Existing Brite Nites customers already on preferred-vendor list

intent_signals: HOA website or community Facebook group shows self-managed or small local management company (no national PM brand)
Zillow or county records indicate neighborhood median home value $350K+ with active HOA dues $150+/month
Google Maps or street view shows 3+ distinct common-area lighting zones (entrances, clubhouse, secondary gates)
Neighborhood has active community events calendar or holiday decoration photos from prior years (signals aesthetics investment)
Board President or Board Secretary contact listed on HOA website or community portal
Community previously ran volunteer holiday light installation (DIY history = conversion opportunity)
Adjacent communities are existing Brite Nites clients (referral-flywheel proximity signal)
Board meeting agendas or minutes (where publicly visible) discuss landscaping or amenity improvement budget items
exclusions: Communities managed by a national or regional management company (route to affluent-managed-communities instead)
Communities with average home values below $350K
Communities with fewer than 3 distinct common-area lighting zones
Budget communities signaling dues below $150/month or active cost-cutting campaigns

intent_signals: Developer LinkedIn page or website lists active residential subdivision or master-planned community projects in BN Tier-1 territories
Marketing Director or VP Marketing title visible at a residential developer with active community launches
Developer is advertising new home sales (model home grand-opening, sales office launch) in target territories
Target home prices in the development are $500K+ (aligns with post-handover affluent-HOA filter)
Developer portfolio shows multiple active projects in the same Tier-1 territory (portfolio opportunity signal)
Job postings for Sales Office Manager or Community Marketing roles signal active grand-opening phase
Developer's amenity plan or marketing materials reference common-area curb appeal as a sales differentiator
exclusions: Affordable housing developers or projects with target home prices below $500K
Commercial or mixed-use developers with no residential HOA formation planned
Developers in Tier-2-only territories where BN cannot support multi-year post-handover continuity
Communities already past HOA handover (route to managed or self-managed segments instead)
